lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 5-6 horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots arranged in a semi-regular grid pattern extending from the posterior gill slits to the caudal region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with horizontal spot rows to form approximately 10-12 distinct columns of anchor nodes across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal side and shadow-biased pixels on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a sparse distribution of approximately 8-10 discrete, small-diameter high-luminance blobs scattered across its visible surface area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A white, linear filamentous appendage is visible trailing from the posterior distal edge of the right pectoral fin; at least five remoras are attached to the ventral and lower posterior flank.
other_distinctive_markers: The cranial region anterior to the gill slits displays a significantly higher density of smaller, stochastic high-luminance spots compared to the grid-like arrangement on the lateral flank.
